a: PII is Personally Identifiable Information (names, emails, phone numbers, etc.).
Collect only the data you need for a stated purpose.
Use personal data only for the purposes disclosed to the user.
Users may request deletion of their personal data under some privacy laws.
Store when/how consent was given and allow withdrawal where required.
Define how long data is kept and delete or anonymize when expired.
Use TLS so data cannot be read while moving across networks.
Encrypt stored data so disk theft does not expose plaintext.
ACLs define who can read/write which resources.
Audit logs record security-relevant actions for forensics and compliance.
GDPR is the EU data protection regulation with strict rules on personal data.
Nigeria's NDPR framework sets rules for processing personal data in Nigeria.
